articles.summary: Discover how the Multi-Max Plus™ auto carrier railcar helps support the evolving automotive supply chain through flexible vehicle loading, improved equipment utilization and efficient rail transportation. Designed to accommodate a wide range of vehicle types, the Multi-Max Plus™ enhances operational efficiency for railroads and automotive manufacturers while supporting sustainable freight movement. Learn how innovative railcar design is helping move finished vehicles across North America and strengthening automotive logistics networks.
